environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate with Aurora PostgreSQL. GraphQL endpoint exposed via API Gateway HTTP API (no request transformation). No query depth limiting or complexity analysis configured. Database user has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE on all tables. Network: service runs in private subnet with NAT gateway for outbound.

config.db_permissions: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON ALL TABLES TO app_user
config.network: Private subnet, NAT gateway, no egress filtering
config.api_gateway: HTTP API passthrough, no request validation
config.graphql_config: No depth limit, no complexity analysis, introspection enabled
